label: W3-measure
text:
How much tile do you need? Three steps.
1. Measure length x width of each part of the room, in metres.
2. Add them up.
3. Add 10% for cuts (15% for herringbone or diagonal).
The tile calculator on every tile page does steps 2 and 3 for you.
Odd-shaped room? Send us a sketch and we'll work it out.
